def: A dual-encoder retriever from Karpukhin et al. (2020): two BERT encoders trained on question-passage pairs with in-batch negatives and dot-product scoring, which outperformed BM25 on open-domain QA.
practice: The reference design for trained dense retrievers and the retriever in the original RAG paper (Lewis et al., 2020); 'DPR-style' usually means a bi-encoder trained this way.
